newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: North Korean defectors arrive in South Korea.
newsitem.headline: North Korean defectors arrive in South Korea.

text.p: Two North Korean families who defected to South Korea by sea earlier on Wednesday arrived at the port of Inchon on board a maritime police helicopter, Yonhap television news reported.
The eight defectors, including five children, stepped out of the Russian-made helicopter aided by South Korean policemen, live television footage showed.
They waved at waiting photographers, saying repeatedly "Thank you, thank you".
The defectors included a distant relative by marriage of North Korea's late president Kim Il-sung, Seoul's Agency for National Security Planning said.
The two families of four sought political asylum after entering South Korean waters in the Yellow Sea between China and the Korean Peninsula, it said.
